why: Worked examples from FIN408, FIN410 and FIN413 slides.

cases.question: A project needs N1,000,000 now and returns N300,000 a year for six years, no residual value, required return 12%. What is the NPV?
Plant A costs N750,000 and returns N150,000 a year for 5 years; Plant B costs N750,000 and returns N200,000 a year for 5 years. Required return 8%. Compute each NPV and say which plant to accept.
An investor bought a security for N2,500,000 a year ago. It is now worth N2,800,000 and paid a dividend of N200,000 during the year. What is the rate of return?
cases.why: FIN410 Portfolio Risk and Return, Example 1

cases.question: An investor puts N6,250,000 into a three-year investment paying 15% a year. How much will it be worth after 3 years?
cases.why: FIN413 Week 1, Example 1 (the slide rounds 1.15^3 to 1.5209 and gets N9,505,625)

cases.question: You can take $1,000,000 at the beginning of each year for 25 years or $10,000,000 today. The discount rate is 10%. Which should you choose?
